verdict: n_experiments prediction essentially exact (2.95 predicted vs 3.00 observed): the stopping-rule axis S=0 (fixed budget) was correctly identified as the driver of how much research happens, and the prediction held on an unseen run. The best_cv_accuracy prediction is uninformative and honestly so: with a real gpt-4o-mini agent the accuracy surrogate has R^2=0.03 and no significant axis, so its 0.96092-vs-0.96330 agreement is not evidence of anything -- both are just 'about 0.96', the ceiling every configuration reaches on this dataset. The validation step confirms the process part of the model (which carries real signal) and declines to trust the outcome part (which does not). This replaces the earlier authored-proposal result, which had reported an emphasis-driven accuracy effect that did not survive putting a real model in the loop.
